name: Mihai Popescu
bio: Mihai's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for the intricate designs of Formula 1 cars, fueled by late-night races broadcasted on Romanian television. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in composite materials. After graduating, he honed his skills at a local aerospace company, gaining invaluable experience in the fabrication and repair of lightweight structures. Now at Reiza Studios Factory, Mihai brings a meticulous and methodical approach to his work, ensuring that every component meets the highest standards of performance and durability. His calm demeanor and sharp eye for detail have made him a respected figure within the team, someone who can always be relied upon to deliver quality, even under pressure.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Mihai is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.
